newsitem.title: CHINA: China says its youth answer army's recruitment call.
newsitem.headline: China says its youth answer army's recruitment call.

text.p: China said on Friday that large numbers of youths across the country had rushed to enlist in the army under a recruitment drive launched this month.
"In cities and villages across the nation an enthusiastic atmosphere has appeared as many youths meeting the age requirement are signing up for recruitment," the People's Daily said.
Authorities began a television and newspaper campaign and opened more recruiting offices to help in the annual recruitment drive, the official daily said.
In Beijing alone about 100,000 young people had registered to join the People's Liberation Army since last Saturday, the Xinhua news agency said.
The official media did not give figures nationwide and there was no indication of how many would actually be inducted into the army this year.
Army recruiters had also imposed tougher political and physical standards for applicants, Xinhua said without elaborating.
China cut the armed forces by nearly 25 percent in the late 1980s to just under 3.2 million in 1990.
